title: After the Queen Elizabeth II Cup: The Way of Magic

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Showcasing her overwhelming strength, Sweep Tosho comes in first.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Though disappointed in their defeat, Kawakami Princess and the others vow to take Sweep Tosho on again. Pleased to hear this, Sweep Tosho smiles.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She says that, alongside her apprentices, she's going to fill the world with even more excitement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, Daiwa Scarlet and Vodka fall under her spell from up in the stands. They, too, are left feeling determined to forge a new future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the little witch continues along her new path with her apprentices. It won't be long before she's casting a brand-new spell on the world with a new generation of Umamusume.
